answers.explanation: Compromise the vendor, and every customer who trusts it is exposed.
SolarWinds. Thousands of customers installed the signed, official update.
SolarWinds' backdoored update was signed. A signature proves who built it, not that their build system was clean.
Multiple suppliers appear under robustness, redundancy, and rapidity alike.
A second way to talk to suppliers is supply chain redundancy.
It lets you move people to where they're needed during an incident.
Containment: the compromise stops at the vendor's own small slice of access.
A software bill of materials (SBOM) tells you which of your systems are affected when a component is compromised.
